entities.name: Pseudo-Marius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pseudo-Marius was a man who claimed to be the son of Gaius Marius the Younger, and therefore the grandson of the famous Roman general Gaius Marius. He was murdered on the orders of Mark Antony following the assassination of Julius Caesar.
